notes.title: 🌊 Swim with us toward World Ocean Day Festival and help us save marine life! 🐳
notes.content:
The ocean is cruicial for our entire planet's ecosystems, producing more oxygen and absorbing more carbon than all the forests combined 💧 This event is all about protecting it and its many incredible inhabitants. 

World Ocean Day Festival is an event by Games For Waves, gaming and streaming community created by Whale and Dolphin Conservation. The goal? To connect gaming industry with real-world conservation efforts. The festival kicks off today and Untold Tales joins in with Samudra + Mythic Ocean bundle and many other titles!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39873559/1100d557d97384564b6d41b5b928ce40cf02a4ba.png

🗓️ From June 5th to 12th, we're pledging 20% of our net profits to Whale and Dolphin Conservation and you get to purchase our games, Samudra + Mythic Ocean bundle included, at deep discounts. This year, every purchase WDC to protect the ocean and the seas from deadly lost and discarded fishing gear! 🛶🎣🐟

[previewyoutube=7TmAZSZtikA;full][/previewyoutube]

 About Samudra + Mythic Ocean bundle

Explore the depths in this bundle!

In Mythic Ocean, experience a narrative adventure built around befriending the gods of the world and shaping the world through your relationship with them. Explore the world and shape it at your pace. There is no combat, so there is no death. Have conversations with the gods that can and will influence the way the world changes. The fate of the world is in your hands!

SAMUDRA is a deep-sea hand-illustrated adventure. Take part in a story designed to be told with no dialogue, accessible to all no matter the language. Discover the secrets of a terribly polluted ocean and the actions that led to its current state. Make the journey to the surface and survive the depths!

💦 So, are you ready to dive in? Support marine life and celebrate the ocean with Samudra + Mythic Ocean bundle:

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/27758/SAMUDRA__Mythic_Ocean/

notes.title: DEMO PATCH v0.1.2⭐
notes.content:
Dear explorers!

We recently proudly announced our new project I NEED SPACE to a positive reception at GCA & GDC in San Francisco! We heard your feedback & suggestions - and now we present the latest patch addressing some of the notes given by those of you who playtested, DM or commented on our pages :)

Demo Patch v 0.1.2 all for more interstellar fun times; 

such as naming the Home Planet & the Cosmicat! ⭐️
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36144563/f2dad0a987ef72d1952c194d4d99664f969f6b82.gif

More visually populated galaxy! ⭐️
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36144563/1d104c1218ade79c7f2a57afecf681194b9001bf.gif

& many more! ⭐️
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36144563/900c92d0f125faf95c7e81e22ca72fc6382d65f2.gif

 💫Updates💫 
- You can now customize the name for the Home planet and the Cosmicat.
- Updated space background visuals with Nebula, Distant planets/ debris & story-related landmarks.
- Added grid to the Constellation mode.
- In-game Constellation can now be saved & viewed in EXTRAS.
- Totems now have dialogues.
- Players can now interact with the Tutus (The small rock creatures).
- Improvements to the player movement and jump physics.
- More minimalistic control scheme for both gamepad & keyboard.
- Improved Journal UI.
- Improved Gameplay UI.
- Cutscenes are now skippable.

✨Write your Ramadhan greetings in the stars!✨
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36144563/a2be7479f367e10bff7c64345e0b2ed25af2013f.gif

Try out the enhanced Constellation Drawing and let your imagination run wild! Write your own special Ramadhan greetings in the stars and submit them to us.

We'll compile all the constellations and post them on our social media pages next week!

---

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2337180/I_NEED_SPACE/

Thank you for your feedback, it really helps us improve! If there’s anything else you’d like to see in I NEED SPACE, shoot us a PM or tell us in Discord #game-suggestions-📕

May this month bring you closer to your loved ones, and may it be filled with countless moments of peace, reflection, and gratitude.

Laters Explorers!
- El & the Khayalan Arts crew

notes.title: A Sneak Peek at ATONE Combat and Music
notes.content:
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41232016/38993a11746e685279592e53ebfab7d29aaa5bb9.png

Hello Midgardians!

ATONE: Heart of the Elder Tree, the upcoming title from our friends at Untold Tales and Wildboy Studios, launches in just 10 short days, so we wanted to provide a nice snippet of combat and a preview of the incredible soundtrack that awaits you. 

FIGHT TO THE BEAT

Combat is all about surviving to the end of the song. Let's have a quick look at a battle against the Ice King in Hard Mode.

[previewyoutube=rv55TIzzBgs;full][/previewyoutube]

Keep focused and stick to the rhythm and you'll land a strike. But make too many mistakes and it'll cost you! 

If you find yourself struggling or unable to vanquish your enemies, there's always Normal Moe which makes the notes appear on 2 rails only. There is also Story Mode, where combat is entirely winnable, every time, allowing you to focus on the incredible narrative.

All fights can then be replayed in the Arena Mode for those wanting that perfect score or certain trophies.

A TASTE OF THE TUNES

We've also got a little sneak peak at the amazing in-game OST, composed by the talented James Shuar also know in the electronica scene as Luminist, as well as contributions from composer Andrew Prahlow (The Outer Wilds). 

Have a listen to "Sons of Fenrir" and transport yourself to the wilds of ATONE.

[previewyoutube=ls_CZHd7p_M;full][/previewyoutube]

Thanks for reading!

♥️ It would be very helpful if you follow and wishlist the game below ♥️

https://store.steampowered.com/app/894620/ATONE_Heart_of_the_Elder_Tree/

notes.title: ATONE: Heart of the Elder Tree joins Untold Tales
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Three years ago, we launched our first ever title as a studio with ATONE: Heart of the Elder Tree. It was received with critical acclaim and won several awards, and we were so humbled by all the support and love for the unique Norse world we created.

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41232016/4005a0aa7ce0f645ef6de4804fc79f41f34448ac.png

Now, we have several announcements to share with you all! 

New Publisher
First up, we're happy to share that we have an official publisher: Untold Tales! They've been a great partner and will support us in all efforts to bring our game to you as smoothly as possible. So go on and give them a follow! -> 

Release Window
Second, we're excited to confirm that we're targeting launch in early 2023. We understand that it's not an exact date, but game development can fluctuate wildly and we don't want to promise something only to disappoint! AND, we'll also be launching on Nintendo Switch, so you can find us there if that's more your style.

Next Fest Demo Available Now
Last but certainly not least, we have a free demo for you to try as part of Next Fest! That's right, it's available now. So keep that axe sharp, you'll need it! And when you're done playing, come back and give us your thoughts. We'd love to hear them!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/894620

If you enjoyed what you played, please wishlist and spread the word, as that helps immensely to increase awareness. Be sure to follow our social channels below for all news and future updates on ATONE.

Twitter: https://twitter.com/UntoldTalesHQ
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/untoldtalesgames
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@untoldtaleshq

Cheers!
Wildboy Studios and Untold Tales

notes.title: UNITY AWARDS 2021 #best-social-impact-projects
notes.content:
Hello Surface-dwellers!

We are excited to announce that SAMUDRA is one of the nominees for the Best Social Impact Project at UNITY AWARD!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36144563/4c811692814a44ee78cc83a4807be1a0c0608c01.jpg

We are deeply honored by this and we'd like to ask for your love and support to vote for SAMUDRA here https://awards.unity.com/#best-social-impact-project whenever you have some free time in the next couple of days :D  (Voting closes on the 2nd of March. )

It's crazy to think that this simple adventure could be nominated alongside these other amazing games - SAMUDRA had always been associated with environmental-focused themes and we are indeed passionate about helping the environments, but it was also a creative endeavor that reflects a personal story of overcoming rock-bottom. In essence, creating this game really did help me as a developer in overcoming my own issues, and serves as an output reflecting my life experiences. So to be recognized this way for something that meant so much to myself is really beyond me 😭

Regardless of the outcome - our team is grateful to have everyone's support here from the Steam community since the days that we launched our first Demo. The team and I have some more exciting plans to share in the future!

Thank you again for all the warm support always!

Have a great weekend everyone 🌱
- El

notes.title: Happy safe Holidays!
notes.content:
Hello fellow Earth-dwellers!

I hope that everyone of you is doing well! Thank you for all the amazing support that you've continuously given us and this project throughout this tough year! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36144563/407aee849d17771764abb918ec046358f7e6e0c1.png

The long strange year of 2020 is finally coming to a close, it goes without saying that our team is no exception when it comes to the challenges and frustrating circumstances that we faced & are still being forced to deal with during this Covid ridden world state, not to mention the daily grind of Indie game development which is already a crazy juggling act to handle - but ultimately, we are deeply grateful for still having one another, for still being able to do what we love the most, for being able to participate in so many digital events & meet so many amazing people from the industry! 

This year SAMUDRA is fortunate enough to have participated in digital exhibitions spanning across 7 countries; starting with GDC (US), Gamescom (Germany), Gameprime (Indonesia) & Tokyo Game Show (Japan) following our Beta release in June, which really helped exposed us to so many like-minded audience globally and locally too! We have since then been featured in STEAM Autumn Game Festival, Le Atmosphere Festival (France), Level Up KL (Malaysia), GStar (Korea). 

The feedbacks and support that we got from each show was tremendous, we are currently nearing the final bits of the development and the team is working hard to implement the relevant adjustments that we got from players, media, critics, curators, publishers that have shared their thoughts on improving the game, so do stay tune for the the final build of this game! 

As for now our schedule release unfortunately is still up in the air for 2021, this is due to an unfortunate Covid situation that affected our team just recently - we are healthy and fine, however we have to regrettably adjust some major chunk of the scheduling due to this, it is frustrating to say the least and it costs us a lot physically, mentally, monetarily, however we are just happy to still have one another. 

Lastly, I would just like to take some time to emphasize the importance of being mindful towards others and the environment, ESPECIALLY during this time. Not to sound preachy - but really its too easy to lose all sense of care when s**t hits the fan. The world is probably in the state that she is in because of human negligence in the first place. Just a little act of eco-friendliness day to day like recycling your utensils, utilizing totebags and other green alternatives instead of single-use plastic, just to name a few examples would really go a long way. 

"The Earth does not belong to man, Man belongs to the Earth."

In retrospect about 1.5 years ago when we started this project SAMUDRA, we wanted to visualize a consequential post-apocalyptic world that was buried within the negative results of human negligence and ignorance, little do we know that literally this year we would be living in one while developing this game. Perhaps its a great time for reflection for some, perhaps its a year of being thankful for others. What. A. Year. 

So please stay safe folks! Keep your spirits up :D

- El
Founder & Head Dev | Khayalan Arts

notes.title: Dive in to SAMUDRA ~
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=l5OLph5kVEc;full][/previewyoutube]

Falling deep into the deep blue sea, you finally awoken at rock-bottom, now its time to journey your way back to the surface. 

SAMUDRA is a hand-illustrated atmospheric experience that takes you through the deepest part of the Sea & Human-condition. This game is a surreal take on a very grounded pollution issue that is rampantly increasing in our dear Ocean, many of the design elements were taken from a real life experience that we the creators are familiar with; mainly Environmental, Cultural & Mental-Health related issues. 

Along the way, you stumble upon epic underwater landscape, creative obstacles & puzzles to solve, quirky characters to encounter & help, creepy antagonists to hide & run from, secrets & collectibles to be discovered and of course lots and lots and lotssss of rubbish. 

The game only requires 1 button + Directional controls to play, and there is no dialog, so everything is up to your interpretation and observation. 

The BETA Demo features the Prologue (tutorial) & skips ahead towards Chapter 2. The full game features a total of 6 Chapters. 

Please let us know your experience with the demo! 

Feel free wishlist and follow our pages:
https://twitter.com/Khayalan_arts
https://www.facebook.com/khayalan.arts.9
https://www.instagram.com/samudra_game/
https://khayalan-arts.itch.io/samudra

Thank you for the support!
